ai.summary: The channel has 94,796 views across 34 videos, but two untagged posts (54,700 and 31,000 views) make up about 90% of that. The movie-tagged parts average roughly 300 views each, and viewers leave fast (8.1s average watch, 1.9% full watch). The biggest lever is holding attention in the first seconds of each part, using the closed-room, twisty style that 10 Cloverfield Lane and Predestination show.
